svg.text: Aqua Edge: Distributed, Offline-First Building Water Monitoring
The network is configured from a
Representative node: same architecture on every node
High flow combined with pressure drop
Detection and alerts happen locally at each node,
nodes to find problems a single
Node set and hierarchy are read
Local water-quality, flat-leakage and abnormal-consumption decisions never depend on cloud connectivity
Outgoing messages are stored locally on the node (SD card)
Messages are forwarded after communication returns
Dashboard snapshots are buffered at the gateway
Snapshots are forwarded when the backend becomes available again
Software validation currently uses four Docker-based virtual nodes with simulated actuators because physical GPIO testing is unavailable.
